prompt:
## Resumo
A cinematic, dark-mode agency / design-studio website built on a deep-plum to warm-ember sunset gradient. A glassy sticky nav sits above a full-bleed hero (a pill 'studio' chip, a huge Space Grotesk display headline with an ember-to-violet gradient-clipped word, a lead paragraph beside a 'Book a studio call' ember pill + a circular 'Watch the reel' play button, a 16:7 showreel video panel, and a 4-up stats strip), followed by a selected-work showcase (a 2-col masonry of big rounded image cards with bottom gradient scrims, hover zoom and an ember arrow chip), an auto-scrolling award/recognition marquee on a plum panel, a 3-column capabilities card grid, a two-up studio/process strip (copy beside a 3-step numbered grid), a dramatic centered sunset-wash contact CTA, and a 4-column dark footer. The signature is the cinematic sunset palette (ink #0a0a0f / #0e0d16 surfaces, plum #3b1d5e, ember #ff7a3d, cream #f4efe9 text), the ember-to-violet gradient-clipped display type, the layered radial sun-bloom glows + SVG film grain, and the gradient-scrim imagery cards. Built with generated layered-gradient 'photography' (no external image assets) so it stays self-contained.

## Estilo Visual
Cinematic dark-mode agency / design-studio landing page on a plum-to-ember sunset gradient. Exact palette via tailwind.config custom colors: ink #0a0a0f (page bg), ink2 #0e0d16 (cards/panels), plum #3b1d5e (deep accent), ember #ff7a3d (the single warm accent), cream #f4efe9 (warm off-white text). Body is bg-ink text-cream antialiased; text steps down by opacity (cream/72, /65, /60, /55, /45). The ONLY chromatic accent is ember #ff7a3d plus the plum->violet it blends into; never use generic indigo/blue as the base. Define a .sunset-wash atmospheric gradient = radial-gradient(120% 90% at 12% 8%, rgba(59,29,94,0.85), transparent 55%), radial-gradient(130% 120% at 88% 18%, rgba(255,122,61,0.42), transparent 50%), radial-gradient(160% 140% at 50% 120%, rgba(255,122,61,0.28), transparent 55%), linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0a0f,#120a1c 45%,#0a0a0f) used on the hero + closing CTA. Display headings use .ember-text = background: linear-gradient(100deg,#ff9b5e 0%,#ff7a3d 38%,#c06ad6 78%,#8b5cf0 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent on the accent word only. Plum panels use .panel-plum = radial-gradient(140% 120% at 20% 0%, rgba(59,29,94,0.6), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(160deg,#150d22,#0c0913). Film grain via .grain::after = an inline SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise data-URI, position:absolute inset-0, opacity .5, mix-blend-mode:overlay. Hairlines = .hairline border-color rgba(244,239,233,0.10); translucent .chip = background rgba(244,239,233,0.04) + 1px hairline border. Generated imagery (no external files): .img-* utilities each layer 2 radial-gradients + 1 linear-gradient in ember/plum/violet to fake cinematic photography, with .work-img transition transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) + filter, and .work-card:hover .work-img { transform: scale(1.045); filter: saturate(1.15) brightness(1.05) }. An infinite .marquee = animation slide 28s linear infinite (translateX 0 -> -50%) duplicated for a seamless loop. Reveal-on-scroll is purely additive: .reveal defaults to opacity:1 (visible for static capture); JS only arms .reveal.armed (opacity 0 + translateY) inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference, then adds .in via IntersectionObserver. ::selection is bg ember on ink. html { scroll-behavior:smooth }. Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:) fill glyphs.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky glass nav
A fixed top-0 inset-x-0 z-50 header. Inside, a nav with backdrop-blur-xl bg-ink/55 and a bottom .hairline border. Inner: mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10, h-[68px] flex items-center justify-between. Left = brand lockup: an 8x8 rounded-lg square filled with linear-gradient(135deg,#ff7a3d,#8b5cf0) holding a ph:sun-horizon-fill (18px, text-ink), beside the wordmark 'Lumen' + 'Atlas' (the 'Atlas' in text-ember), font-display font-700 tracking-tight text-[18px]. Center (hidden lg:flex gap-9 text-[13.5px] text-cream/70 font-medium): Work / Capabilities / Recognition / Studio, each hover:text-cream. Right = a solid pill CTA 'Start a project' (bg-cream text-ink text-[13.5px] font-semibold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full hover:bg-ember) with a ph:arrow-up-right-bold.

### Hero (full-bleed cinematic)
A .sunset-wash .grain relative overflow-hidden section. Behind the content, two pointer-events-none blurred radial orbs: a ~640px ember circle (blur-[120px] opacity-60) top-right and a ~520px plum circle (blur-[130px] opacity-50) mid-left. Content: relative mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10, pt-[148px] pb-20 -> lg:pt-[180px] lg:pb-28. Top: a flex chip row (mb-8) = a .chip rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] 'Independent design studio' + a hidden-sm cream/45 location line 'Sydney - Lisbon - remote everywhere'. Then the H1: font-display font-700 leading-[0.92] tracking-[-0.02em] text-[clamp(2.6rem,8.4vw,7.2rem)] = 'Cinematic <ember-text>websites</ember-text> that feel inevitable.'. Below (mt-9), a grid lg:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr] gap-10 items-end: left a max-w-xl lead paragraph (text-cream/72) describing the studio; right (lg:justify-end) a CTA cluster = an ember pill 'Book a studio call' (bg-ember text-ink font-semibold px-6 py-3.5 rounded-full + ph:arrow-right-bold) and a 'Watch the reel' link (a 9x9 rounded-full hairline-bordered circle with ph:play-fill + label, text-cream/80).

### Hero showreel panel + stats strip
Inside the hero, below the copy (mt-14 -> lg:mt-20): a group rounded-[20px] overflow-hidden .hairline-bordered panel with shadow-2xl shadow-black/60. Its body is an .img-helio .reel-shimmer .grain block at aspect-[16/8] -> sm:aspect-[16/7] with an absolute top gradient scrim (from-ink/70), a centered play button (a 20x20 rounded-full bg-cream/95 text-ink with ph:play-fill, group-hover:scale-105), a bottom-left caption (a pulsing ember dot + 'Showreel 2026 - 01:48' in font-display text-[13px] tracking-[0.18em] uppercase), and a top-right .chip 'Sound on'. Then (mt-10) a stats strip: a grid grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-4 gap-px (on a rgba(244,239,233,0.08) base so the gap reads as hairlines), rounded-2xl overflow-hidden .hairline border. Four bg-ink2 cells (px-5 py-6), each a big font-display font-700 number (text-[clamp(1.6rem,2.4vw,2.3rem)], the first '120+' in text-ember) over a text-[12.5px] cream/55 label: 120+ sites shipped / 9 yrs crafting the web / 14 design awards / 4.2s avg. load -> launch.

### Selected work showcase
Section id=work, bg-ink py-24 -> lg:py-32, mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10. Header (mb-14, flex-col -> sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between): left an ember eyebrow 'Selected work' over an H2 'Brands that needed to feel different.'; right a 'See the full archive' link (text-cream/70 border-b hairline pb-1 + ph:arrow-up-right-bold). Below, a grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-5 -> lg:gap-7 of four .work-card anchors. Two are full-width features (md:col-span-2): a generated-gradient .work-img (aspect-[16/8]) with .grain, an absolute from-ink/85 via-ink/10 bottom scrim, and a bottom row (p-7 -> lg:p-10, flex items-end justify-between) = a meta line (uppercase tracking-[0.18em] cream/65 font-display: 'Pique Coffee - ember dot - Brand site + commerce' / 'Tideline - Climate fintech') + a display H3 (text-[clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.4rem)]) and a 12x12 rounded-full bg-cream/95 text-ink arrow chip that turns bg-ember on group hover. Two are half-width cards (aspect-[4/3.4]): a generated-gradient .work-img + from-ink/85 scrim + a bottom block (p-6 -> lg:p-7) with a small uppercase meta line ('Helio Labs - SaaS' / 'Noor Studio - Portfolio') and a display H3 (text-[clamp(1.3rem,2.2vw,1.8rem)]). All cards rounded-2xl overflow-hidden .hairline-bordered.

### Recognition marquee (auto-scroll)
Section id=awards, .panel-plum .grain border-y .hairline py-20 -> lg:py-24 overflow-hidden. Header inside mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10 (mb-12, flex-col -> lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between): an H2 'Recognized where it counts.' (text-[clamp(1.8rem,3.6vw,2.8rem)]) + a max-w-md cream/65 paragraph about Awwwards/FWA/CSSDA/Webby. Then a full-bleed marquee: a relative wrapper with absolute left/right 24-wide gradient fade masks (from-[#100a1b]). Inside, a flex w-max .marquee (animation slide 28s linear infinite) containing the SAME set of chips twice (the 2nd aria-hidden) for a seamless loop. Each .award-chip = display:flex items-center gap-14px, padding 18px 22px, rounded-16px, background rgba(244,239,233,0.04), 1px hairline border, white-space:nowrap, min-width 230px: an ember ph: fill icon (ph:trophy-fill / ph:star-four-fill / ph:medal-fill / ph:seal-check-fill / ph:sparkle-fill / ph:crown-fill) + a 2-line label (.ac-t font-display font-600 15px title, .ac-s 12.5px cream/50 subtitle), e.g. 'Site of the Day / Awwwards - Pique'.

### Capabilities grid
Section id=capabilities, bg-ink py-24 -> lg:py-32, mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10. Header (max-w-2xl mb-14): ember eyebrow 'What we do' + an H2 'One studio, the whole <ember-text>website</ember-text>.' (text-[clamp(2rem,4.4vw,3.4rem)]) + a cream/65 intro paragraph. Then a grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of six cards. Each card: rounded-2xl .hairline border bg-ink2 p-7 hover:bg-[#13101d] transition, containing an 11x11 rounded-xl icon chip (background linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,122,61,.22),rgba(139,92,240,.22))) holding an ember ph: fill glyph (22px), a font-display font-600 text-[1.18rem] title, and a text-[14px] cream/60 description. The six: Art direction (ph:compass-tool-fill), UX & UI design (ph:cursor-click-fill), Motion & WebGL (ph:film-reel-fill), Front-end build (ph:code-fill), Design systems (ph:squares-four-fill), Launch & growth (ph:rocket-launch-fill).

### Studio / process strip
Section id=studio, bg-ink2 border-y .hairline py-20 -> lg:py-24, mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10, grid lg:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr] gap-14 items-center. Left: ember eyebrow 'The studio' + an H2 'Small team. Outsized output.' (text-[clamp(1.9rem,3.8vw,3rem)]) + a max-w-lg cream/65 paragraph + a ghost pill 'Meet the team' (rounded-full .hairline border px-5 py-3, hover:bg-cream hover:text-ink, + ph:arrow-right-bold). Right: a grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-px (on a rgba(244,239,233,0.08) base for hairline gaps), rounded-2xl overflow-hidden .hairline border, three bg-ink p-6 cells, each an ember font-display text-[12px] tracking-[0.18em] uppercase index (01/02/03), a font-display font-600 text-[1.05rem] step title (Discover / Design / Ship), and a text-[13px] cream/55 line.

### Closing contact CTA
Section id=contact, .sunset-wash .grain relative overflow-hidden, with a single big bottom-center blurred ember orb (~700x900, blur-[140px] opacity-60). Content: relative mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10 py-28 -> lg:py-40 text-center. A status .chip (px-4 py-1.5, a pulsing ember dot + '2 project slots open - Q3 2026'); a giant H2 'Let's build the <ember-text>one they remember.</ember-text>' (font-display font-700 tracking-[-0.02em] leading-[0.94] text-[clamp(2.6rem,7.5vw,6rem)]); a max-w-xl mx-auto cream/72 subline; then (mt-10) a flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4 button row = a solid email pill 'hello@lumenatlas.studio' (bg-cream text-ink font-semibold px-7 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-ember + ph:arrow-up-right-bold) and a ghost 'Book a 20-min call' pill (rounded-full .hairline border px-7 py-4, + ph:calendar-dot-fill).

### Footer (4-column)
A footer bg-ink border-t .hairline. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10 py-16: a grid md:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr] gap-10. First block: the brand lockup (gradient sun-horizon square + 'Lumen' + ember 'Atlas') + a max-w-xs cream/55 blurb + a social row of four 9x9 rounded-full hairline-bordered icon buttons (ph:x-logo-bold, ph:instagram-logo-bold, ph:dribbble-logo-bold, ph:linkedin-logo-bold) that hover:bg-cream hover:text-ink. Then three link columns, each a font-display font-600 text-[13px] tracking-[0.16em] uppercase cream/45 heading + a space-y-3 text-[14px] cream/65 list: Studio (Work/Capabilities/About/Recognition), Services (Brand sites/Web apps/Design systems/Motion & WebGL), and Studios (two ember ph:map-pin-fill location rows Sydney/Lisbon + an email). Below: a mt-14 pt-7 border-t .hairline flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justify-between text-[13px] cream/45 legal row = a copyright + a group of Privacy / Terms links + 'Made on an infinite canvas.'.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Sunset-wash atmospheric gradient (.sunset-wash + sun-bloom orbs) — The signature cinematic backdrop on the hero and the closing CTA: a deep-plum-to-warm-ember sunset built from layered radial + linear gradients, with big blurred radial 'sun bloom' orbs floating behind the content so the dark page feels lit from off-screen.
Define .sunset-wash { background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 12% 8%, rgba(59,29,94,0.85), rgba(59,29,94,0) 55%), radial-gradient(130% 120% at 88% 18%, rgba(255,122,61,0.42), rgba(255,122,61,0) 50%), radial-gradient(160% 140% at 50% 120%, rgba(255,122,61,0.28), rgba(10,10,15,0) 55%), linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0a0f 0%,#120a1c 45%,#0a0a0f 100%) }. Layer pointer-events-none absolute blurred orbs inside hero/CTA: an ember circle (h/w ~640px, blur-[120px], opacity-60, background radial-gradient(circle,#ff7a3d,transparent 70%)) top-right and a plum circle (~520px, blur-[130px], opacity-50, #3b1d5e) mid-left; on the CTA a single ~700x900 ember orb bottom-center. Always pair with .grain for film texture.

### Ember-to-violet gradient-clipped display word (.ember-text) — The recurring brand flourish: in each big headline a single word is filled with a warm ember-to-coral-to-violet gradient clipped to the glyphs, so the type itself carries the hero's sunset color while the rest of the heading stays cream.
Define .ember-text { background: linear-gradient(100deg,#ff9b5e 0%,#ff7a3d 38%,#c06ad6 78%,#8b5cf0 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; color:transparent }. Apply it to ONE word in the hero H1 ('websites'), the capabilities H2 ('website'), and the closing CTA H2 ('one they remember.') only, never to whole headings or body text.

### Generated gradient 'photography' image cards (.img-* + .work-card hover) — Self-contained cinematic imagery with no external assets: each work/showreel image is a stack of ember/plum/violet radial + linear gradients standing in for a photo, with a bottom from-ink scrim for legible captions and a slow scale+saturate hover on the work cards.
Build .img-pique / .img-helio / .img-noor / .img-tide each as 2 radial-gradients + 1 linear-gradient mixing ember (#ff7a3d / #ff9b5e), plum (#3b1d5e) and violet (#8b5cf0) at different positions + a dark base (e.g. .img-helio { background: radial-gradient(70% 90% at 20% 20%, rgba(139,92,240,0.85), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(90% 110% at 90% 90%, rgba(255,155,94,0.8), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(135deg,#160d26,#3b1d5e 130%) }). Give .work-img { background-size:cover; transition: transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), filter .9s ease } and .work-card:hover .work-img { transform: scale(1.045); filter: saturate(1.15) brightness(1.05) }. Always overlay an absolute from-ink/85 bottom gradient scrim and a .grain layer so white captions stay readable; cards are rounded-2xl overflow-hidden with a .hairline border.

### Infinite recognition marquee (.marquee + edge fades) — An auto-scrolling, seamlessly looping row of award chips on the plum recognition band, with gradient fade masks at both edges so chips dissolve rather than hard-cut.
A relative wrapper with two absolute inset-y-0 w-24 z-10 gradient masks (left from-[#100a1b] to-transparent, right mirrored). Inside, a flex w-max .marquee where .marquee { animation: slide 28s linear infinite } and @keyframes slide { from { transform: translateX(0) } to { transform: translateX(-50%) } }; duplicate the identical chip group twice (2nd aria-hidden) so the -50% wrap is seamless. Each .award-chip is a rounded-16px rgba(244,239,233,0.04) panel with a 1px hairline border, min-width 230px, white-space:nowrap, holding an ember ph: fill icon + a 2-line label (display 15px title + 12.5px cream/50 subtitle).

### SVG film grain overlay (.grain) + capture-safe reveal — A fine fractal-noise film grain layered over the cinematic surfaces for a filmic texture, plus a scroll-reveal system engineered to default to visible so static/full-page screenshots are always complete.
Define .grain { position:relative } and .grain::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:.5; mix-blend-mode:overlay; background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,...feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='3'...") } on the hero, CTA, panels and imagery. For motion, keep .reveal { opacity:1; transform:none } as the default (so captures show content); only inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) does .reveal.armed get opacity:0 + translateY(26px) with a transition, and JS uses an IntersectionObserver to add .in (with a staggered transition-delay) when each element scrolls into view. Never make the visible state depend on JS.

## Notas Especiais
Frameless, fully responsive cinematic agency / design-studio marketing site (no browser chrome / no device frame): every section centers in mx-auto max-w-[1280px] with px-6 -> lg:px-10; the nav is fixed + glassy (backdrop-blur-xl bg-ink/55) with links hidden below lg; the hero stats strip is grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-4; the work grid is md:grid-cols-2 with two md:col-span-2 feature cards; capabilities go 1 -> 2 -> 3 cols; the studio strip is lg:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr] with a 1 -> sm:3 process grid; the footer is md:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr] collapsing to 1 col; everything stacks on mobile. Built with Tailwind via CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering the cinematic colors (ink #0a0a0f, ink2 #0e0d16, plum #3b1d5e, ember #ff7a3d, cream #f4efe9) and the two font families (Space Grotesk display, Inter body, both via Google Fonts); icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:) fill glyphs. All imagery is generated from layered CSS gradients (no external image files), so the page is fully self-contained. All copy and the 'Lumen Atlas' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped: the transferable value is the cinematic sunset palette (deep plum #3b1d5e -> warm ember #ff7a3d over near-black #0a0a0f surfaces with warm cream #f4efe9 text, NOT generic indigo/blue), the ember-to-violet .ember-text gradient-clipped display word, the layered .sunset-wash + blurred sun-bloom orbs + SVG film grain, the gradient-scrim hover-zoom imagery cards, the infinite award marquee, and the full agency layout (glass nav -> cinematic hero with showreel + stats -> big-imagery work showcase -> recognition marquee -> capabilities grid -> studio/process strip -> dramatic sunset CTA -> 4-column footer), NOT the specific studio.

style.prompt_typography: Two Google Fonts: Space Grotesk (weights 400;500;600;700) as font-display, and Inter (400;500;600) as font-body / the default body face, with -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased. Every heading + eyebrow + stat number uses font-display font-700/600. Hero H1: font-display font-700 leading-[0.92] tracking-[-0.02em] text-[clamp(2.6rem,8.4vw,7.2rem)] (the accent word in .ember-text). CTA H2: text-[clamp(2.6rem,7.5vw,6rem)] tracking-[-0.02em] leading-[0.94]. Section H2: text-[clamp(2rem,4.6vw,3.6rem)] tracking-tight leading-[0.95]. Eyebrows: font-display font-600 text-[12.5px] uppercase tracking-[0.22em] in ember/90. Stat numbers: font-display font-700 text-[clamp(1.6rem,2.4vw,2.3rem)] (first one in text-ember). Lead paragraph: text-[clamp(1rem,1.4vw,1.22rem)] leading-relaxed text-cream/72. Body copy: text-[14px]-[15.5px] text-cream/60-65 leading-relaxed (Inter). Card titles: font-display font-600/700; uppercase micro-labels on imagery: text-[11-11.5px] tracking-[0.18em] font-display.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column, vertically stacked, frameless responsive marketing site (no browser chrome / no device frame). Almost every section centers inside mx-auto max-w-[1280px] with px-6 -> lg:px-10. Order top to bottom: a fixed glassy nav; a full-bleed .sunset-wash hero (chip row, giant display headline, lead + CTA row, a 16:7 showreel video panel with a play button, and a 2->4-col stats strip); a selected-work showcase (a md:grid-cols-2 set of rounded image cards: two full-width feature cards spanning both columns and two half-width cards, each a generated-gradient image with a bottom from-ink scrim, an uppercase project meta line, a display title, and an ember-on-hover circular arrow); an auto-scrolling recognition marquee on a .panel-plum band with edge fade masks; a capabilities grid (sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 of six icon-chip cards); a studio/process strip (lg:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr]: left copy + ghost button, right a sm:grid-cols-3 numbered 01/02/03 process grid with hairline gaps); a dramatic centered .sunset-wash contact CTA (status chip, huge display headline, subline, email pill + book-a-call ghost button); and a 4-column footer (md:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr]: brand + social, two link columns, a studios/location column) with a hairline bottom legal row. Reflow: nav links hide below lg (the 'Start a project' pill stays); the hero stats strip is grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-4; the work feature cards keep md:col-span-2 while the two middle cards are half-width on md+; capabilities 1 -> 2 -> 3 cols; the studio strip stacks below lg and the process grid is 1 -> sm:3; the footer stacks to 1 col on mobile; CTA buttons stack on mobile.

prompts.prompt: A fixed top-0 inset-x-0 z-50 header. Inside, a nav with backdrop-blur-xl bg-ink/55 and a bottom .hairline border. Inner: mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10, h-[68px] flex items-center justify-between. Left = brand lockup: an 8x8 rounded-lg square filled with linear-gradient(135deg,#ff7a3d,#8b5cf0) holding a ph:sun-horizon-fill (18px, text-ink), beside the wordmark 'Lumen' + 'Atlas' (the 'Atlas' in text-ember), font-display font-700 tracking-tight text-[18px]. Center (hidden lg:flex gap-9 text-[13.5px] text-cream/70 font-medium): Work / Capabilities / Recognition / Studio, each hover:text-cream. Right = a solid pill CTA 'Start a project' (bg-cream text-ink text-[13.5px] font-semibold px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full hover:bg-ember) with a ph:arrow-up-right-bold.

A .sunset-wash .grain relative overflow-hidden section. Behind the content, two pointer-events-none blurred radial orbs: a ~640px ember circle (blur-[120px] opacity-60) top-right and a ~520px plum circle (blur-[130px] opacity-50) mid-left. Content: relative mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10, pt-[148px] pb-20 -> lg:pt-[180px] lg:pb-28. Top: a flex chip row (mb-8) = a .chip rounded-full px-3.5 py-1.5 text-[12px] 'Independent design studio' + a hidden-sm cream/45 location line 'Sydney - Lisbon - remote everywhere'. Then the H1: font-display font-700 leading-[0.92] tracking-[-0.02em] text-[clamp(2.6rem,8.4vw,7.2rem)] = 'Cinematic <ember-text>websites</ember-text> that feel inevitable.'. Below (mt-9), a grid lg:grid-cols-[1.15fr_0.85fr] gap-10 items-end: left a max-w-xl lead paragraph (text-cream/72) describing the studio; right (lg:justify-end) a CTA cluster = an ember pill 'Book a studio call' (bg-ember text-ink font-semibold px-6 py-3.5 rounded-full + ph:arrow-right-bold) and a 'Watch the reel' link (a 9x9 rounded-full hairline-bordered circle with ph:play-fill + label, text-cream/80).

prompts.partPt: Topo Principal (Hero) showreel panel + Números e Resultados strip
prompts.prompt: Inside the hero, below the copy (mt-14 -> lg:mt-20): a group rounded-[20px] overflow-hidden .hairline-bordered panel with shadow-2xl shadow-black/60. Its body is an .img-helio .reel-shimmer .grain block at aspect-[16/8] -> sm:aspect-[16/7] with an absolute top gradient scrim (from-ink/70), a centered play button (a 20x20 rounded-full bg-cream/95 text-ink with ph:play-fill, group-hover:scale-105), a bottom-left caption (a pulsing ember dot + 'Showreel 2026 - 01:48' in font-display text-[13px] tracking-[0.18em] uppercase), and a top-right .chip 'Sound on'. Then (mt-10) a stats strip: a grid grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-4 gap-px (on a rgba(244,239,233,0.08) base so the gap reads as hairlines), rounded-2xl overflow-hidden .hairline border. Four bg-ink2 cells (px-5 py-6), each a big font-display font-700 number (text-[clamp(1.6rem,2.4vw,2.3rem)], the first '120+' in text-ember) over a text-[12.5px] cream/55 label: 120+ sites shipped / 9 yrs crafting the web / 14 design awards / 4.2s avg. load -> launch.

Section id=work, bg-ink py-24 -> lg:py-32, mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10. Header (mb-14, flex-col -> sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between): left an ember eyebrow 'Selected work' over an H2 'Brands that needed to feel different.'; right a 'See the full archive' link (text-cream/70 border-b hairline pb-1 + ph:arrow-up-right-bold). Below, a grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-5 -> lg:gap-7 of four .work-card anchors. Two are full-width features (md:col-span-2): a generated-gradient .work-img (aspect-[16/8]) with .grain, an absolute from-ink/85 via-ink/10 bottom scrim, and a bottom row (p-7 -> lg:p-10, flex items-end justify-between) = a meta line (uppercase tracking-[0.18em] cream/65 font-display: 'Pique Coffee - ember dot - Brand site + commerce' / 'Tideline - Climate fintech') + a display H3 (text-[clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.4rem)]) and a 12x12 rounded-full bg-cream/95 text-ink arrow chip that turns bg-ember on group hover. Two are half-width cards (aspect-[4/3.4]): a generated-gradient .work-img + from-ink/85 scrim + a bottom block (p-6 -> lg:p-7) with a small uppercase meta line ('Helio Labs - SaaS' / 'Noor Studio - Portfolio') and a display H3 (text-[clamp(1.3rem,2.2vw,1.8rem)]). All cards rounded-2xl overflow-hidden .hairline-bordered.

Section id=awards, .panel-plum .grain border-y .hairline py-20 -> lg:py-24 overflow-hidden. Header inside mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10 (mb-12, flex-col -> lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between): an H2 'Recognized where it counts.' (text-[clamp(1.8rem,3.6vw,2.8rem)]) + a max-w-md cream/65 paragraph about Awwwards/FWA/CSSDA/Webby. Then a full-bleed marquee: a relative wrapper with absolute left/right 24-wide gradient fade masks (from-[#100a1b]). Inside, a flex w-max .marquee (animation slide 28s linear infinite) containing the SAME set of chips twice (the 2nd aria-hidden) for a seamless loop. Each .award-chip = display:flex items-center gap-14px, padding 18px 22px, rounded-16px, background rgba(244,239,233,0.04), 1px hairline border, white-space:nowrap, min-width 230px: an ember ph: fill icon (ph:trophy-fill / ph:star-four-fill / ph:medal-fill / ph:seal-check-fill / ph:sparkle-fill / ph:crown-fill) + a 2-line label (.ac-t font-display font-600 15px title, .ac-s 12.5px cream/50 subtitle), e.g. 'Site of the Day / Awwwards - Pique'.

Section id=capabilities, bg-ink py-24 -> lg:py-32, mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10. Header (max-w-2xl mb-14): ember eyebrow 'What we do' + an H2 'One studio, the whole <ember-text>website</ember-text>.' (text-[clamp(2rem,4.4vw,3.4rem)]) + a cream/65 intro paragraph. Then a grid sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of six cards. Each card: rounded-2xl .hairline border bg-ink2 p-7 hover:bg-[#13101d] transition, containing an 11x11 rounded-xl icon chip (background linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,122,61,.22),rgba(139,92,240,.22))) holding an ember ph: fill glyph (22px), a font-display font-600 text-[1.18rem] title, and a text-[14px] cream/60 description. The six: Art direction (ph:compass-tool-fill), UX & UI design (ph:cursor-click-fill), Motion & WebGL (ph:film-reel-fill), Front-end build (ph:code-fill), Design systems (ph:squares-four-fill), Launch & growth (ph:rocket-launch-fill).

Section id=studio, bg-ink2 border-y .hairline py-20 -> lg:py-24, mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10, grid lg:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr] gap-14 items-center. Left: ember eyebrow 'The studio' + an H2 'Small team. Outsized output.' (text-[clamp(1.9rem,3.8vw,3rem)]) + a max-w-lg cream/65 paragraph + a ghost pill 'Meet the team' (rounded-full .hairline border px-5 py-3, hover:bg-cream hover:text-ink, + ph:arrow-right-bold). Right: a grid sm:grid-cols-3 gap-px (on a rgba(244,239,233,0.08) base for hairline gaps), rounded-2xl overflow-hidden .hairline border, three bg-ink p-6 cells, each an ember font-display text-[12px] tracking-[0.18em] uppercase index (01/02/03), a font-display font-600 text-[1.05rem] step title (Discover / Design / Ship), and a text-[13px] cream/55 line.

prompts.partPt: Closing contact Chamada Final para Ação
prompts.prompt: Section id=contact, .sunset-wash .grain relative overflow-hidden, with a single big bottom-center blurred ember orb (~700x900, blur-[140px] opacity-60). Content: relative mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10 py-28 -> lg:py-40 text-center. A status .chip (px-4 py-1.5, a pulsing ember dot + '2 project slots open - Q3 2026'); a giant H2 'Let's build the <ember-text>one they remember.</ember-text>' (font-display font-700 tracking-[-0.02em] leading-[0.94] text-[clamp(2.6rem,7.5vw,6rem)]); a max-w-xl mx-auto cream/72 subline; then (mt-10) a flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justify-center gap-4 button row = a solid email pill 'hello@lumenatlas.studio' (bg-cream text-ink font-semibold px-7 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-ember + ph:arrow-up-right-bold) and a ghost 'Book a 20-min call' pill (rounded-full .hairline border px-7 py-4, + ph:calendar-dot-fill).

A footer bg-ink border-t .hairline. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1280px] px-6 -> lg:px-10 py-16: a grid md:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr] gap-10. First block: the brand lockup (gradient sun-horizon square + 'Lumen' + ember 'Atlas') + a max-w-xs cream/55 blurb + a social row of four 9x9 rounded-full hairline-bordered icon buttons (ph:x-logo-bold, ph:instagram-logo-bold, ph:dribbble-logo-bold, ph:linkedin-logo-bold) that hover:bg-cream hover:text-ink. Then three link columns, each a font-display font-600 text-[13px] tracking-[0.16em] uppercase cream/45 heading + a space-y-3 text-[14px] cream/65 list: Studio (Work/Capabilities/About/Recognition), Services (Brand sites/Web apps/Design systems/Motion & WebGL), and Studios (two ember ph:map-pin-fill location rows Sydney/Lisbon + an email). Below: a mt-14 pt-7 border-t .hairline flex-col -> sm:flex-row items-center justify-between text-[13px] cream/45 legal row = a copyright + a group of Privacy / Terms links + 'Made on an infinite canvas.'.

special_ui_components.description: The signature cinematic backdrop on the hero and the closing CTA: a deep-plum-to-warm-ember sunset built from layered radial + linear gradients, with big blurred radial 'sun bloom' orbs floating behind the content so the dark page feels lit from off-screen.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define .sunset-wash { background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 12% 8%, rgba(59,29,94,0.85), rgba(59,29,94,0) 55%), radial-gradient(130% 120% at 88% 18%, rgba(255,122,61,0.42), rgba(255,122,61,0) 50%), radial-gradient(160% 140% at 50% 120%, rgba(255,122,61,0.28), rgba(10,10,15,0) 55%), linear-gradient(180deg,#0a0a0f 0%,#120a1c 45%,#0a0a0f 100%) }. Layer pointer-events-none absolute blurred orbs inside hero/CTA: an ember circle (h/w ~640px, blur-[120px], opacity-60, background radial-gradient(circle,#ff7a3d,transparent 70%)) top-right and a plum circle (~520px, blur-[130px], opacity-50, #3b1d5e) mid-left; on the CTA a single ~700x900 ember orb bottom-center. Always pair with .grain for film texture.

special_ui_components.description: The recurring brand flourish: in each big headline a single word is filled with a warm ember-to-coral-to-violet gradient clipped to the glyphs, so the type itself carries the hero's sunset color while the rest of the heading stays cream.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define .ember-text { background: linear-gradient(100deg,#ff9b5e 0%,#ff7a3d 38%,#c06ad6 78%,#8b5cf0 100%); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; color:transparent }. Apply it to ONE word in the hero H1 ('websites'), the capabilities H2 ('website'), and the closing CTA H2 ('one they remember.') only, never to whole headings or body text.

special_ui_components.description: Self-contained cinematic imagery with no external assets: each work/showreel image is a stack of ember/plum/violet radial + linear gradients standing in for a photo, with a bottom from-ink scrim for legible captions and a slow scale+saturate hover on the work cards.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build .img-pique / .img-helio / .img-noor / .img-tide each as 2 radial-gradients + 1 linear-gradient mixing ember (#ff7a3d / #ff9b5e), plum (#3b1d5e) and violet (#8b5cf0) at different positions + a dark base (e.g. .img-helio { background: radial-gradient(70% 90% at 20% 20%, rgba(139,92,240,0.85), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(90% 110% at 90% 90%, rgba(255,155,94,0.8), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(135deg,#160d26,#3b1d5e 130%) }). Give .work-img { background-size:cover; transition: transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), filter .9s ease } and .work-card:hover .work-img { transform: scale(1.045); filter: saturate(1.15) brightness(1.05) }. Always overlay an absolute from-ink/85 bottom gradient scrim and a .grain layer so white captions stay readable; cards are rounded-2xl overflow-hidden with a .hairline border.

special_ui_components.description: An auto-scrolling, seamlessly looping row of award chips on the plum recognition band, with gradient fade masks at both edges so chips dissolve rather than hard-cut.
special_ui_components.prompt: A relative wrapper with two absolute inset-y-0 w-24 z-10 gradient masks (left from-[#100a1b] to-transparent, right mirrored). Inside, a flex w-max .marquee where .marquee { animation: slide 28s linear infinite } and @keyframes slide { from { transform: translateX(0) } to { transform: translateX(-50%) } }; duplicate the identical chip group twice (2nd aria-hidden) so the -50% wrap is seamless. Each .award-chip is a rounded-16px rgba(244,239,233,0.04) panel with a 1px hairline border, min-width 230px, white-space:nowrap, holding an ember ph: fill icon + a 2-line label (display 15px title + 12.5px cream/50 subtitle).

special_ui_components.component: SVG film grain overlay (.grain) + capture-safe reveal
special_ui_components.description: A fine fractal-noise film grain layered over the cinematic surfaces for a filmic texture, plus a scroll-reveal system engineered to default to visible so static/full-page screenshots are always complete.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define .grain { position:relative } and .grain::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; opacity:.5; mix-blend-mode:overlay; background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,...feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='3'...") } on the hero, CTA, panels and imagery. For motion, keep .reveal { opacity:1; transform:none } as the default (so captures show content); only inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) does .reveal.armed get opacity:0 + translateY(26px) with a transition, and JS uses an IntersectionObserver to add .in (with a staggered transition-delay) when each element scrolls into view. Never make the visible state depend on JS.

structured.special_notes: Frameless, fully responsive cinematic agency / design-studio marketing site (no browser chrome / no device frame): every section centers in mx-auto max-w-[1280px] with px-6 -> lg:px-10; the nav is fixed + glassy (backdrop-blur-xl bg-ink/55) with links hidden below lg; the hero stats strip is grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-4; the work grid is md:grid-cols-2 with two md:col-span-2 feature cards; capabilities go 1 -> 2 -> 3 cols; the studio strip is lg:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr] with a 1 -> sm:3 process grid; the footer is md:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr] collapsing to 1 col; everything stacks on mobile. Built with Tailwind via CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering the cinematic colors (ink #0a0a0f, ink2 #0e0d16, plum #3b1d5e, ember #ff7a3d, cream #f4efe9) and the two font families (Space Grotesk display, Inter body, both via Google Fonts); icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:) fill glyphs. All imagery is generated from layered CSS gradients (no external image files), so the page is fully self-contained. All copy and the 'Lumen Atlas' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped: the transferable value is the cinematic sunset palette (deep plum #3b1d5e -> warm ember #ff7a3d over near-black #0a0a0f surfaces with warm cream #f4efe9 text, NOT generic indigo/blue), the ember-to-violet .ember-text gradient-clipped display word, the layered .sunset-wash + blurred sun-bloom orbs + SVG film grain, the gradient-scrim hover-zoom imagery cards, the infinite award marquee, and the full agency layout (glass nav -> cinematic hero with showreel + stats -> big-imagery work showcase -> recognition marquee -> capabilities grid -> studio/process strip -> dramatic sunset CTA -> 4-column footer), NOT the specific studio.
